latest.notes:
Music is now laid against your breaks' REAL lengths, not the lengths you set.

The stop set length you configure is a limit for traffic to fill against. It was also being used to size the hour, which is wrong in both directions. With a 3:00 stop set holding 2:00 of spots, every hour was handing back a minute of airtime it could have given to music. With one that overruns, the hour ran long — and that overrun is what gets shaved minutes before the top of the hour, throwing away songs the scheduler had already counted as played when it built the rest of the day. Those songs were then held back for the rest of the day, or with a multi-day same-song setting for days, without ever going to air.

A full regenerate now re-picks the music once the commercial log is in, when each break's length is the sum of the spots actually in it. Spare break time goes to music, and music that won't fit is never scheduled at all — so it stays in rotation instead of being scheduled and binned.

Building a log now takes about twice as long, because the day is laid out twice. If the commercial fill fails, the second pass is skipped rather than sizing your hours as though the station had no commercials.
